landing.title: Primary learning gets fun with Kiko!
landing.lead: Practice for grades 1–6, 8 subjects, in Indonesian & English. Just a few minutes a day.
landing.why1.title: Fun, not scary
landing.why1.body: Mistakes are okay. Kiko always cheers you on.
landing.why2.title: Always fresh questions
landing.why2.body: Practice adapts to your child's level.
landing.why3.title: Safe for kids
landing.why3.body: No ads and no third-party trackers.
landing.freeNote: Free version: Math, Global Perspectives, and Art & Design, units 1–{units}.
landing.priceNow: Early-bird price Rp{early}/month, locked while subscribed, then Rp{normal}/month.
landing.priceNote: The yearly plan saves 2 months. We email a reminder before your subscription ends, and you renew it yourself.
landing.faq1.a: Primary grades 1 to 6, with content inspired by the Cambridge Primary curriculum.
landing.faq2.a: We only store a nickname, grade and avatar. No child email, photo or location.
landing.faq3.q: Do I need internet all the time?
landing.faq3.a: No. After the first visit, learning still works with a weak signal.
landing.disclaimer: StudyKids is not affiliated with Cambridge University Press & Assessment.
